svg.title: Tremor Scroll: the glyph set
svg.desc: The Tremor Scroll's glyphs scratched white in smoked paper: four faces (east, south, west, north, each an arrow and a letter) by three strengths (one, two or three strokes of the needle), and beside them the two odd marks: none, and the faint ripple that comes on every face at once.
svg.text: FACE BY THE ARROW AND THE LETTER · STRENGTH BY THE STROKES
